title: ChatGPT Enterprise Access
content: User must complete mandatory training and AI Literacy Assessment. After completion, raise a OneConnect request and obtain Reporting Manager approval.

title: ChatGPT Missing Invitation
content: If no invitation is received, verify manager approval, check spam or junk folders and allow the documented waiting period.

title: ChatGPT Login Issue
content: Verify enterprise access approval and ensure the user signs in using approved corporate credentials.

title: ChatGPT Access Upgrade
content: Higher tier or upgraded ChatGPT access requires the approved request process after training completion.

title: OpenAI API Access
content: Users must complete training, raise a OneConnect request and obtain reporting manager approval before API access.

title: OpenAI API Key Creation
content: After access approval, users can log into the OpenAI platform, select the assigned project and create a secret API key.

title: OpenAI API Key Security
content: API keys must never be shared through email, chat, tickets, screenshots or source code repositories.

title: OpenAI API Authentication
content: Authentication requires a valid approved account and API key generated under the correct project.

title: OpenAI API Project Selection
content: Users should select the same project configured during the access request process.

title: Codex Installation
content: Codex is an OpenAI coding assistant used for code generation, developer productivity and debugging. Installation requires the Codex App Request Form and a network connected laptop.

title: Codex Access
content: Codex requires approved OpenAI API access and appropriate project assignment.

title: Codex Authentication
content: Authentication requires a valid API key created from the approved OpenAI project.

title: Codex VS Code Setup
content: Codex can be integrated into development environments such as VS Code through supported extensions and API authentication.

title: Codex Troubleshooting
content: Users experiencing Codex issues should verify API access, project alignment and active authentication credentials.

title: Codex Developer Productivity
content: Codex helps developers with code generation, debugging, suggestions and engineering productivity improvements.

title: Partner U Registration
content: Partner U registration requires Partner ID HCL-001 and corporate email registration.

title: Partner U Login
content: Partner U access uses registered credentials and password reset procedures when necessary.

title: Partner U Two Factor Authentication
content: Partner U may require two factor authentication setup and verification.

title: Hackathon Setup
content: Hackathon participants should verify required software, local admin permissions and approved OpenAI access.

title: Developer Environment Setup
content: Developers should install VS Code, required runtimes, Git and supporting tools before beginning development.

title: NodeJS Requirement
content: Some development tools require an installed and properly configured NodeJS environment.

title: VS Code Installation
content: VS Code should be installed with approved extensions and development tool integrations.

title: Knowledge Base Escalation
content: Cases with insufficient confidence should be escalated for human review.

title: Support Case Creation
content: Each support interaction generates a unique support case identifier and stores conversation history.

title: Human Escalation Process
content: Low confidence responses, knowledge gaps and unresolved issues should be escalated to human support teams.
